title: Education minister condemns killing of Maguindanao Sur school principal

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The education minister of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) condemned the killing of a school principal in Datu Saudi Ampatuan, Maguindanao del Sur on Wednesday morning. Dr. Dionel Villabito Mahusay, Ed.D., principal of Pendililang Piang Elementary School in Barangay Salbu, Datu Saudi Ampatuan town, was shot while he was driving his minivan on his way to school at 7:30 a.m. “We strongly condemn this act of violence. Principal Mahusay was an educator who served our children and our community,” Minister Naguib Sinarimbo of the Ministry of Basic, Higher and Technical Education (MBHTE) said in a […]...
